name: branding-social-profile-cards-with-logo-avatars-in-violet-and-white
title: Two profile cards on black: outlined and filled violet circle avatars over a violet half-banner with a Follow pill
whatItIs: A black field with two rounded white cards each with a violet top half, a circular avatar holding the logo (violet on white, and white on violet), name, handle, bio, counts, link and a black Follow pill.
whatItMeans: Clean and practical; testing avatar versions shows how the mark sits in a circle.
techniques: Test the logo in a circle in two colourways.
Split the card into colour banner and white body.
Overlap the avatar across the split.

vocabulary.definition: A logo placed inside a circular profile picture.
A card with a coloured top and white body.
Showing two colour versions of a logo.
